contexts.text: To roll themselves in ashes = to be condemned on account of falsity.
Be revolved abstractly in the mind.
The understanding, while revolving this, or turning it over.
To turn over and revolve means.
The evil which he actually intends rolls itself through the Spirits around.
Those who rolled themselves from Heaven.
When anything (the pope says) is contradicted, he feels something rolling and creeping in his abdomen.
To roll themselves in ashes = mourning on account of the destroyed truth of the Church.
